features.description: Align `/bookings` to the mission's guest-booking design contract while preserving current copy, CTA labels, destinations, and signed-in/signed-out handoffs. Use the existing page as the visual source of truth and tighten the public hub's responsive layout for mobile-first booking entry.
preconditions: Guest booking mission AGENTS guidance is in place
Shared server on port 3000 is available for browser verification
Workers understand that `/bookings` is the visual source of truth, not a redesign target with new behavior
expectedBehavior: The `/bookings` hero, card headings, supporting copy, and CTA labels remain unchanged unless a tiny UX wording fix is explicitly justified
`Browse restaurants` still goes to `/restaurants`
`View my bookings` preserves the existing signed-out redirect and signed-in destination behavior
`Sign in` still targets `/auth/signin?redirectedFrom=/bookings`
Mobile layout keeps the cards stacked, CTAs full-width, and avoids horizontal scrolling
verificationSteps: Manual: verify `/bookings` on mobile and desktop against the validation contract, including CTA targets and signed-out auth handoff

features.description: Bring `/restaurants/[slug]/book` onto the same guest-booking visual system as `/bookings` without changing the route's venue resolution, step model, or booking behavior. Keep the discovery-to-booking handoff coherent and measurable across the two surfaces.
preconditions: Bookings hub design contract is understood as the visual source of truth
Restaurant booking route and `ReservationWizardClient` remain the canonical entry into the wizard
No backend/slug-resolution changes are required
expectedBehavior: Valid restaurant slugs still load the venue-scoped booking wizard and invalid slugs still resolve to not-found behavior
The booking route shares guest-booking shell language, card treatment, and CTA prominence with `/bookings`
The `/bookings` to restaurant-discovery to restaurant-booking journey feels like one consistent frontend system without changing route behavior
verificationSteps: Manual: compare `/bookings` and `/restaurants/[slug]/book` on mobile and desktop for shell continuity and preserved slug behavior

features.description: Align the canonical public and guest booking-detail surfaces to one shared bookings-system shell without changing their route-specific access behavior. Focus this feature on visible summary, card, and layout consistency only.
preconditions: Shared detail implementation path through `src/app/(public)/bookings/booking-page.tsx` is understood
Recovery and auth route semantics are treated as immutable and out of scope for this feature
Detail UI changes remain frontend-only
expectedBehavior: Public and guest detail surfaces stay on the shared shell pattern while preserving existing summary and action affordances
No route-guard, redirect, or token semantics are changed by this shell-alignment work
verificationSteps: pnpm exec vitest run tests/guest/guest-bookings-params.test.ts tests/guest/guest-view-models.test.ts --reporter=verbose
Manual: verify `/bookings/[bookingId]` and `/guest/bookings/[bookingId]` share the same visual shell pattern on mobile and desktop

features.description: Align the in-flow confirmation state and the restaurant thank-you surfaces with the guest booking design system while preserving existing copy, route destinations, and the canonical restaurant thank-you redirect chain.
preconditions: Restaurant booking wizard confirmation state remains inside the existing step-4 flow
Restaurant thank-you routes remain public and redirect topology stays unchanged
The feature does not replace the lightweight thank-you card with a new receipt flow
expectedBehavior: Wizard confirmation still shows guest-safe booking essentials before exit
`/restaurants/[slug]/book/thank-you` keeps its current lightweight confirmation experience and CTA set
`/restaurants/[slug]/thank-you` still redirects into the canonical thank-you route
verificationSteps: Manual: verify the wizard confirmation state plus both restaurant thank-you entry routes on mobile and desktop

features.description: Improve the booking wizard for fast one-hand mobile use while preserving current plan gating, details validation, review/edit loops, sticky navigation behavior, and guest-safe confirmation/error messaging.
preconditions: The restaurant booking shell alignment feature has landed or is understood
The worker will preserve the Plan → Details → Review → Confirmation state model
No server/API behavior changes are needed to satisfy the validation contract
expectedBehavior: Plan step still blocks progression until a real bookable plan is complete
Details step still enforces current guest contact rules before review
Mobile sticky navigation remains reachable and does not clip or cover controls
Review preserves entered booking data and safe back/edit behavior
Submit outcomes remain guest-safe across confirmation, duplicate, offline, and timeout recovery states
verificationSteps: Manual: run the mobile booking flow on `/restaurants/[slug]/book`, covering plan gating, details validation, sticky actions, review/edit, and guest-safe submit states

features.description: Unify the detailed confirmation and management destinations so receipt and detail surfaces share a stable mobile-first summary/action hierarchy, preserve receipt access rules, and keep rebook continuity back into the correct restaurant booking flow.
preconditions: Receipt and detail surfaces continue to rely on shared booking primitives
Token-based receipt access remains valid and distinct from deprecated public detail token handling
Rebook behavior continues to route through the existing restaurant booking flow
expectedBehavior: `/guest/bookings/[bookingId]/receipt` remains the canonical detailed confirmation surface
Receipt access rules still distinguish signed-in entry, token-only entry, and sign-in redirect fallback
Token-only receipt entry still shows the manage-faster sign-in prompt
Public/guest detail and receipt surfaces keep a stable mobile summary/action hierarchy
`Book Again` still returns guests to the correct restaurant booking flow when a usable slug exists
verificationSteps: Manual: verify thank-you, receipt, and detail mobile action hierarchy, token-only receipt prompt, and rebook continuity into `/restaurants/[slug]/book`

features.description: Complete the confirmation/redirect continuity work by preserving the canonical thank-you-to-receipt chain, top-level thank-you alias behavior, and redirect-only checkpoint routes across the guest booking journey.
preconditions: Canonical thank-you, receipt, and detail surfaces are already identified and remain unchanged as destinations
Alias behavior is treated as a route invariant
This feature does not own recovery failure-state UI
expectedBehavior: `/bookings/[bookingId]/thank-you` and `/thank-you?bookingId=...` still funnel into the canonical receipt route with query continuity
Confirmation exits still flow into the canonical receipt journey when booking identity exists
Redirect-only aliases continue to behave as checkpoints, not standalone experiences
verificationSteps: pnpm exec vitest run tests/guest/public-booking-redirects.test.ts tests/guest/guest-bookings-params.test.ts tests/guest/guest-view-models.test.ts --reporter=verbose
Manual: verify `/bookings/[bookingId]/thank-you`, `/thank-you?bookingId=...`, confirmation exit chains, and alias redirect continuity

features.description: Harden recovery-route behavior and guest-safe failure states across public detail, receipt, and recovery error pages without changing canonical destinations or backend semantics.
preconditions: Alias and receipt handoff behavior remains unchanged
Recovery route semantics stay server-owned and frontend work must preserve them
Shared detail and receipt fallback components are available to extend
expectedBehavior: Recovery route still maps invalid token states safely and sanitizes `next`
Recovery error page still shows code-specific guest-safe guidance with only the current exit actions
Receipt load failures stay in a guest-safe fallback state instead of exposing raw errors
Degraded recovery sessions on public detail fail into the shared guest-safe detail error state
verificationSteps: Manual: verify `/bookings/recover/error`, degraded detail fallback, and receipt error fallback states

features.description: Protect the public and guest booking-detail route contracts while frontend consistency work lands. Preserve recovery-link handoff, auth redirects, and deprecated-token behavior so shell changes do not break access semantics.
preconditions: Detail shell alignment work is complete or understood
Route guards and recovery handoffs are treated as immutable behavior contracts
This feature may adjust thin route wrappers or guard-related UI only as needed to preserve behavior
expectedBehavior: Public recovery-link entry still strips access tokens from the final detail URL after handoff
Public and guest unsigned access still redirect to the correct sign-in targets
Legacy `?token=` detail access still fails through the deprecated recovery path
No shell-consistency change regresses booking-detail route guards
